QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] Naran's Worries
QuestInfo.0: Naran of Mu Lung has a favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: There's been a drop in visitors from outside and it's because of the Red-Nose Pirates. Naran would like them gone.
QuestInfo.2: You got rid of 50 Red-Nose Pirates and Captains. The herbs they have can be poisonous, depending on how they are stored.

default.0: How are matters with the Red-Nose Pirates?
